sections.description:
📢 Select template, customize and get your website live with Met StarterKit templates. It all happens in less than 30 seconds!

Say hello to the Met StarterKit – the ultimate web design template library crafted and developed specifically to empower every WordPress user to build fully branded and professionally designed websites. Building your dream site has never been so fast, so enjoyable, and completely code-free! Met StarterKit enables you to create website designs with the most up-to-date modern elements that seamlessly adapt to your website goals.

Automated implementation of pre-designed templates can eliminate manual web design work and save time thinking about business development. This WordPress starter template plugin is perfectly suited for any niche, offering a diverse collection of templates for bloggers, portfolios, businesses, e-commerce, and beyond.

🌟 Key Features of Met StarterKit Templates

👉 World-class design and visual assets.

👉 Available with free website templates.

👉 Complete website templates kit, with one-click import.

👉 All crucial pages, sections, & components.

👉 Drag and drop template’s content editing and design customization.

👉 Large library of Gutenberg & Elementor templates.

👉 All customizable layouts to match your brand identity.

👉 Responsive templates to fit all device screens.

👉 Support global typography & color controls.

👉 Switch between different templates effortlessly.

How Met StarterKit Ensures a Game-changing WordPress Experience?

Met StarterKit is one of the best WordPress starter template plugins. Let’s see how it’s bringing a breakthrough in the WordPress website-building journey with pre-designed website templates.

➡️ Get Entire Websites Live in a Few Clicks!

With Met StarterKit, you’re not just limited to sections or page layouts—you get complete starter templates. Easily import a complete website template pack with a single click and launch your site instantly! This breakthrough streamlines the entire website-building workflow for both beginners and experts.

➡️ An organized hub to scale your brand

Met StarterKit ships with a wide range of web layouts for every need. Whether a specific section, Gutenberg block patterns, or an entire page, its pre-designed templates let you effortlessly shape any part of your website—no creative effort required!

➡️ Free WordPress Starter Templates

Imagine you’re spending no money and having professionally designed website templates for your next business like a Gym center, flower shop, digital product shop, construction, consultancy, or conference. Yes, Met StarterKit is offering all of these stunning pre-made website templates for absolutely free. Another beneficial point is, that WordPress users are also enjoying free Elementor and Gutenberg templates.

➡️ Hand-crafted Layouts with Original Images

With Met StarterKit, you will find each template is meticulously designed with aesthetics and deeper functionality in mind. The color combination and beautifully structured layouts enhance the readability and user experience. You won’t find any hurdles when adjusting the layout according to your needs. Plus, all the visual templates are combined with high-quality and copy-right-free images and visual assets.

➡️ Brand New Templates Every Week!

To keep you apart from the crowd, Met StarterKit constantly produces new templates. You will always find brand new templates to explore new options. Our design team focuses on new niches or industries and redefines their design approach based on modern trends and practices. Therefore, you will find Met StarterKit templates are crafted with a fresh and user-friendly appearance.

➡️ Ready Templates for Both Elementor and Gutenberg

Met StarterKit is fully compatible with both Elementor and Gutenberg. You will get the same visual building environment to drag and drop template elements effortlessly. This template plugin gives the ultimate freedom to tailor pre-made templates with widgets or block-based editors. So, you can enjoy the best of both worlds with versatile and adaptable layouts.

For Gutenberg users, it has a versatile Gutenberg pattern library. The team behind Met StarterKit also has developed popular Elementor and GutenKit products like: ElementsKit, ShopEngine, MetForm, GutenKit, etc.

➡️ Fully Customizable Layouts

Every template of Met StarterKit is exceptionally customizable. After importing a layout, you can easily edit and modify anything from an intuitive interface to match your specific needs without requiring coding skills. You can easily change column structure, padding, and margin. Furthermore, you can personalize the layout through typography and color combinations.

➡️ Productivity boosting

Met StarterKit speeds up your workflow by eliminating the need to build templates from scratch. It accelerates the web design process, allowing you to focus more on growing your business rather than spending time on repetitive design tasks.

➡️ Templates for Absolutely Any Niche, All in One!

Access to a large template library and the most-suited fully designed templates for any niche and industry. Met StarterKit template has templates for personal, organizational, and e-commerce-based websites. This vast template library includes industry-specific designs tailored to meet your needs.

sections.installation:
Prerequisite: Must have Gutenberg Block Editor installed and enabled. For WordPress 5.0 or higher versions, Gutenberg is the default editor.

Installation Process 1:

  1. Go to the WordPress Dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for Met Starter Template
  4. Install and Activate the plugin.

OR

Step 1: Download the Met Starter Template WordPress plugin.

Step 2: Go to Plugin > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the plugin file.

Step 3: After successful installation, just click on the activation button to activate Met StarterKit Template.

Step 4: Navigate to Appearance > Starter Templates

Is it responsive for all screens?

Yes, it is fully responsive for all devices and tested for cross-browser compatibility.
sections.changelog:
3.0.0 – 2025-12-02

  • Added: Changelog drawer and video popup for enhanced user guidance
  • Added: Global Styles Reset API to manage spacing in Gutenberg templates
  • Added: Live Preview button on the template preview page
  • Added: Back button on the template preview page and after successful installation
  • Added: Redirect mechanism to improve user experience when reloading during installation
  • Added: Gutenkit & ElementsKit widget and module status update API
  • Added: Template preview error message if the preview fails to load
  • Fixed: Page URL not updating in Gutenberg templates
  • Fixed: Markgear template import issues
  • Fixed: Height issues on the template preview page
  • Fixed: Menu creation issues in Elementor templates
  • Fixed: Header and Footer not deleting properly
  • Improved: Template library data fetching for better performance
  • Improved: Template preview content fetching mechanism for a better user experience
  • Improved: Installation complete page UI
  • Improved: Dashboard UI accessibility

2.0.0 – 2025-08-13

  • Added: ElementsKit Template support with Elementor
  • Added: Gutenkit Template support with Gutenberg
  • Added: Template customization features (coming soon)
  • Added: Live demo responsive preview
  • Added: Site information with option to retain existing data
  • Added: Template filtering functionality.
  • Added: Favorite template saving feature.
  • Added: Features like contact form, PopupKit, WooCommerce, etc. (now available for exploration)
  • Added: New utility function getLastProcessedStep for tracking installation steps
  • Added: Random UUID generation function with documentation
  • Added: Content replacement logic in replaceContent
  • Fixed: Gutenkit template demo import issue
  • Tweaked:: Improved user-friendly UI update
  • Tweaked:: Enhanced error handling in API resolvers
  • Tweaked:: Better slug generation logic in makeSlugUnique
  • Tweaked:: Updated particle options for better readability
  • Improved: Code quality and documentation

1.0.0 – 2024-12-10

  • Inital Release
  • Core template import functionality
